rule:
Phase 2 Stage A (read-only): detector threshold / inference-resolution sweep on VALIDATION photos only.

Selection rule, fixed before looking at any result:
  among all (imgsz, conf) settings with all-sign precision >= 0.90 on the validation photos, pick the one with the
  highest end-to-end accuracy on the 26-class validation signs (found AND correctly classified); ties -> fewer
  false detections, then faster. The chosen setting (and the current default, 1280 / 0.25) is then evaluated ONCE
  on the test photos for reporting only.
Outputs go to D:\DL_phase2\stage_a (nothing in the project is modified).
